args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. SRE agent rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy production release, across all regions. Post-rollback verification shows all regions healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up needed to investigate the regression in v2.3.1 before attempting redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 (the most recent release with a healthy production track record) across all three regions.
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: INC-0001 (SEV2) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy", documenting the failure, rollback, and verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up recommended: investigate the regression in v2.3.1 before any redeploy attempt.
